Monitoring_indicator: Wholesale-retail gap, dealer inventory, discounts, registrations
Mitigation: Stage buys; prefer entry-level breadth and low-cost operators; reduce if inventory rises with retail weakness.

Monitoring_indicator: Steel, aluminium, copper, rubber, battery materials, gas, freight
Mitigation: Stress-test gross margin; review supplier pass-through, hedges, dual sourcing and price actions.

Monitoring_indicator: Export volumes, destination mix, shipping time, insurance and FX
Mitigation: Avoid single-destination dependence; diversify OEM and supplier exposure; preserve cash.

Monitoring_indicator: EV share, contribution margin, warranty claims, utilisation, localisation
Mitigation: Use staged exposure; demand evidence of cost parity and positive unit economics before scaling.

Monitoring_indicator: Compliance capex, fleet efficiency, product mix and homologation
Mitigation: Prefer manufacturers with multi-powertrain engineering and visible compliance roadmaps.

Monitoring_indicator: Loan rates, approvals, delinquencies, average ticket size
Mitigation: Monitor affordability and lender quality; avoid over-weighting entry-level credit-sensitive demand.

Monitoring_indicator: Single-source parts, lead times, buffer stocks, supplier liquidity
Mitigation: Prefer OEMs with qualified alternates and supplier support; review critical tier-2 dependencies.

Monitoring_indicator: Recall notices, warranty provisions, complaints, service campaigns
Mitigation: Treat repeated quality problems as thesis-breaking; diversify OEM exposure.

Monitoring_indicator: INR, imported components, export receivables and hedges
Mitigation: Balance exporters and domestic businesses; monitor net natural hedge.

Monitoring_indicator: Index and company P/E vs own history, earnings revisions, breadth
Mitigation: Require margin of safety; rebalance after sharp rerating; do not chase theme momentum.

Monitoring_indicator: Recall/cyber events, software updates, data incidents
Mitigation: Monitor governance, patching and supplier standards; treat repeated incidents seriously.

Monitoring_indicator: Inventory days, wholesale vs retail, receivables and cash conversion
Mitigation: Prefer stock turns and cash generation over headline dispatch growth.
